mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia increase risk of statin-related myopathy and rhabdomyolysis; loop diuretics may reduce simvastatin efficacy through volume depletion effects on hepatic metabolism.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent; counsel on muscle pain/weakness symptoms and adjust statin dose if myopathy signs emerge.
